info.name: Portal App - Assistant & RAG
info.description: Manual test requests for the assistant chat, docs/code RAG search, item research (Sourcebot/KB/Genny Studio), and /api/ask endpoints. Run `npm run dev` first. Import this file directly into Postman (File > Import).

request.description: Reports chat model (local Ollama or cloud) and docs/code embedding provider status.

item.name: Docs search (RAG only, no chat model)

request.description: Pure retrieval — embeds the query, returns top matching docsKb chunks. No chat model call, no Graph auth needed.

item.name: Assistant chat (full bot, needs Graph login)

request.description: Full multi-tool assistant (Graph + search_docs + search_code). Requires a cached Graph token at .local-auth/graph-tester-token.json — run `npm run graph-tester` and sign in once first, or this returns 401.
Runs Sourcebot code search + aris_search (Genny Studio) or KB fallback, returns a structured report plus codeFindings/kbFindings tabs.
Separate from /api/assistant/chat — driven by ASK_PROVIDER (openai | teamgpt | local), not ASSISTANT_MODEL_MODE.
